report.summary: Account linking via Account Aggregator failed starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00 due to an expired SSL certificate on the external dependency aa-fiu-gateway, causing 100% failure rates in aa-connector and elevated error rates in mobile-bff.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Expired SSL certificate on external aa-fiu-gateway

supporting.note: Explicitly states SSL handshake failed because the certificate expired at notAfter=2026-10-08T13:30:00Z.
Shows FI fetch failed for consents with upstream errors starting at 13:30.
Error rate anomaly started precisely at 13:30.
Error rate anomaly started precisely at 13:30 due to synchronous calls to aa-connector.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Regression introduced by aa-connector deployment chg-8692

supporting.note: Deploy on aa-connector occurred prior to the incident window.

contradicting.note: Log explicitly identifies an expired certificate (notAfter=2026-10-08T13:30:00Z) on the external gateway rather than a software regression.

facts.text: aa-connector error rate anomaly started at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00 and peaked at 104.34%
aa-connector p99 latency dropped sharply at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00 as requests failed immediately
mobile-bff error rate anomaly started at 2026-10-08T13:30:00+00:00
SSL handshake with aa-fiu-gateway failed because the certificate expired at 2026-10-08T13:30:00Z
FI fetch failed for multiple consents with upstream error starting at 2026-10-08T13:30:23+00:00
mobile-bff makes a synchronous call to aa-connector
aa-connector makes synchronous calls to aa-fiu-gateway and user-db
aa-connector had a deploy (v8.18.8 minor bug fixes) on 2026-10-07T01:22:00+00:00

assumptions: The external partner failed to renew or automate rotation of the aa-fiu-gateway certificate, explaining why internal metrics for aa-fiu-gateway showed normal request counts while connection attempts failed at the TLS handshake layer.

timeline.event: aa-connector and mobile-bff error rate anomalies begin
SSL certificate on aa-fiu-gateway expired, causing SSL handshake failures
FI fetch failed for consent ee143657 due to upstream error

recommended_actions.action: Coordinate immediately with the external aa-fiu-gateway provider to renew and deploy a valid SSL certificate.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly resolves the expired certificate causing 100% account linking failures.

recommended_actions.action: Implement automated certificate expiration monitoring and alerting for all external dependencies.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future silent expirations from going unnoticed until runtime connection failures occur.
